product.name: Praxis AI Platform
product.description: An AI platform designed to unify manufacturing data, deploy AI/ML models, and enable smart automation to reduce unplanned downtime and optimize manufacturing processes.

product.name: Predictive Maintenance Application
product.description: An AI-driven tool that tracks and predicts machine downtime on critical manufacturing equipment to reduce unplanned failures.

product.name: Production Optimization Application
product.description: A customizable AI engine that generates efficient production schedules to optimize manufacturing workflows.

product.name: Procurement Management Application
product.description: An AI tool that automates inventory management, order compliance, and supplier risk mitigation through custom forecasting.

product.name: Max.e Manufacturing Co-Pilot
product.description: An AI assistant that supports technicians, engineers, and executives by querying machine issues, connecting data sources, and building custom visualizations.
